title: Winter Jam
seo_title: Winter Jam Christian Music Night in Springfield, MO
description: Winter Jam is a night of Christian music and worship featuring Crowder, Anne Wilson, Andy Mineo ft. Magic & Bird, Strings & Heart, Terrian, Red, and NewSong, with a message from speaker Zane Black. A Pre-Jam Party with Natural State, CJ Emulous, and Mary-Clair comes first, and entry is a $15 donation at the door with no advance tickets needed; general admission doors open at 6:00 PM. It takes place Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
